name: The Ayurveda National Hospital of Sri Lanka
conditions_text: General Ayurvedic medicine, teaching hospital
reviews: Went to this hospital as I live close to it and needed treatment. Very disorganized place. People are mostly kind but disorganized and no hygiene practices at all. I was asked to go to the canteen and buy a pair of gloves and the person selling food just handed me the gloves in a very unsterile manner. The treatment room bed had large patches of blood and was very unclean.

The Ayurveda National Hospital of Sri Lanka, located in Rajagiriya, stands as the premier institution for traditional Ayurvedic medicine in the country. It is highly regarded for providing excellent, authentic, and high-quality Ayurveda treatment to patients across the island.
good service. There is a teaching hospital. But i kindly request that they should ask patients opinion before we use them as learning materials.
Perfect place for get Ayurwedic treatments from well experienced doctors. you can take medicines for many long lasting illnesses. its a teaching hospital also.
address: No.325 Dr.N.M.Perera Mawatha, Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte

name: Ayu Lanka Ayurveda Hospital - Enderamulla
conditions_text: Steam treatment, full body wellness, general ailments
reviews: I visited Ayu Lanka for a full steam treatment, and it was a wonderful experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very relaxing. A special thanks to Uthpala, who carried out my treatment with great care and professionalism.
I had a very positive experience at Ayu Lanka Hospital. The staff were professional, caring, and made me feel comfortable throughout my treatment. The environment was clean, peaceful, and welcoming.

Today I visited Ayu Lanka Enderamulla for a full steam treatment. My experience was really amazing. The full body massage was relaxing and professionally done. The staff were caring and courteous. The facility was clean, well maintained and peaceful.

Excellent Services and great job team. The staff of the institution is very kind, including the chief doctor Dr. Chamila Nishadari, all the doctors are very kind and friendly in treating both physical and mental illnesses.

name: Ayu Lanka Ayurveda Hospital - Sigiriya
conditions_text: Stomach issues, general treatment, massage therapy
reviews: Amazing experience with such a nice people! We met the owner at the restaurant and he invited us to help my boyfriend. He has problems with stomach and this clinic took care of him and us.

Me and my girlfriend had the full body, the herbal steam bath and herbal fomentation. This was easily the best massage and experience we have had. Staff explained all treatments and let us choose from many choices.

I had a fantastic experience here, it started with a consultation and then after I went into my treatments. The full body massage was wonderful and so relaxing. I also had a steam bath and shirodhara.
I've visited this place several times for a massage, and today I had the best massage I've experienced so far in Sri Lanka. Bhagya was absolutely amazing.

name: Ayu Lanka Ayurveda Hospital - Kottawa
conditions_text: Elbow pain, general ailments
reviews: Had the best therapy out there at Ayu Lanka Kottawa. A mind relaxing, soothing massage with a proper consultation. The staff was even amazing and they had a warm welcome.
HIGH Professional treatment i ever feel. Calm atmosphere, clean area, professional & helpfull therapist, you must try their treatment as once in your life.
I was suffering with elbow pain last week. The doctors & nurses treated me well. I feel so much better. Thank you Ayu Lanka team for your kindness.
Very qualified staff with good care

name: Adhitya Ayurveda (Anuradhapura)
conditions_text: Heart conditions, neck pain, weight loss, pre-bypass alternative treatment
reviews: This is a great place to get your treatment specially for people who were told to do a bypass surgery. The treatment of course is longer but results from people who have gone through Dr. S S Gunawardena have claimed results of cure beyond expectations. The luxury rooms are like a hotel room with all facilities.

One of my best friend in UK he recommended Adhitya Ayurveda Centre, I came here to obtain some treatment for severe neck pain and stiffness along with weight loss program and diet plan. I'm really happy about the treatment methods and services I received.

Spent here 6 days anuradhapura hospital just returned how I joined. No betterment in any condition. Joined for muscle stiffness and back pain nobody asked where the pain is just did treatment, booked for 7 days but vacated after 5th day, when I inform I want to go early they were very keen on not refunding my money.

Dr. S.S. Gunawardena is a proven and renowned traditional/Ayurvedic doctor, well known for treating many health conditions, especially heart-related issues. This place offers both treatments and wellness packages, and they are truly worth it.

name: Siddhalepa Ayurveda Spa
conditions_text: Plantar fasciitis, musculoskeletal, general wellness
reviews: Last Tuesday we myself and my wife have done full body massage. It was a great session we enjoyed very much with highest relaxation. Supun and Ayesha were our Therapist and they were very professional.

I went with my Wife to get a foot massage for myself and a neck/shoulder massage for her. I have a bad case of Plantar fasciitis. Upon arriving at the Spa, we were checked in by the resident doctor who did a thorough but quick examination.

Anoma and the staff at Siddhalepa go beyond their duty to give a great massage service. The space inside the spa was beautiful. All staff are experienced, professional and help you to feel relaxed and calm.

I had a wonderful half-day experience at Siddhalepa Clinic. My therapist, Ayesha, was professional, attentive, and highly skilled. The half-day package is a must-try and offers excellent value for money.

name: Ceylon Hospital (Yakkala)
conditions_text: Back pain, sciatica, knee pain
reviews: I had the opportunity to get treatment for my grandmother's back pain at Ceylon Hospital, Yakkala. We were very satisfied with the service provided by the hospital staff. Everyone was caring, professional, and attentive to our needs.
I am receiving treatment for sciatica at Ceylon Hospital under Dr. Rusiru. I have been attending treatment for the past 5 days. Since starting treatment with her, I have felt significant improvement.
I had a very positive experience with Dr. Udeni Dhanushka. The doctor was professional, patient, and compassionate throughout my mother's visit.

Yesterday I went with my wife for her knee pain. After delaying nearly 1 hour than our appointment time we get to meet the doctor. This process was excruciatingly painful for her as she nearly cried several times.
notes: Mixed reviews on pain management approach

name: Ayurveda Sarana Beach Hospital
conditions_text: Calcific shoulder, hypertension, Panchakarma (14-18 day programs)
reviews: I recently completed a 14-day stay at this wonderful Ayurveda clinic in Sri Lanka, and I cannot recommend it highly enough. The entire medical team and staff were incredibly caring, attentive, and professional throughout my stay.

I have just finished up an 18 day panchakarma treatment here, and I am so so happy I came. From the moment I entered the centre, I felt so taken care of and looked after. The Doctor is very attentive.

Now it's nearly 2 months ago since I finished my Ayurveda in Sarana Beach Hospital. Thank you so much Dr. Ravindra for you helping hands and your support. I'm so thankful that I came to your new place.
I camped here for my scouting hike and it was a really nice place I enjoyed my short while there and give thanks to the wonderful owner and the kind and helpful staff.

name: Ayuthantra Ayurveda & Wellness
conditions_text: Hip pain, foot injury/swelling, meniscus injury, personalized diet plans
reviews: Initially, we came to Ayuthantra Wellness for my husband's hip pain, and it was relieved within just two massage sessions. Later, after he had a fall, his foot was badly swollen and we were extremely worried.

I visited Ayuthantra for the first time last week, and although the charges are a bit pricey, the overall experience exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for genuine care.
I've been visiting Ayuthantra for the past 4-5 years, and the experience has always been consistently excellent. Doctor Udari's knowledge and expertise are truly impressive.
I recently went for my second treatment at Ayuthantra, and I must say the experience was truly wonderful. The treatments were carried out with great care and professionalism.

name: Sirimavo Bandaranayake Govt Ayurvedic Hospital
conditions_text: General Ayurvedic treatment, free medicine
reviews: We are very grateful for the excellent Ayurvedic treatment my mother received. The doctor was extremely kind, patient, and took time to understand her pain. We have seen a clear improvement.
Good service... Government Hospital.. Nice and quiet place...
A meditating place located with various kinds of views. Looks more like a resort to me than a hospital.
No crowd at all. Get ur medicines freely

name: Adhitya Ayurveda Colombo
conditions_text: Shirodhara, head oil massage, doctor-supervised treatment
reviews: I recently visited Adithya Ayurveda in Colombo with my mother, and we had an absolutely wonderful experience. The environment is peaceful, relaxing, and beautifully maintained. The treatments were excellent and provided a truly rejuvenating experience.
While in Colombo, we did a 5 day treatment package with Adhitya. Upon booking the reception was responsive and informative, and the treatments we had were completely restorative.
I've always known Adhitya Ayurveda Colombo for their treatments, but I didn't expect their food to be this good. The cookies are honestly amazing.

Had a wonderful experience at this Ayurvedic spa. The ambience is peaceful, relaxing, and beautifully maintained. All treatments are carried out under the supervision of a doctor, which gave me added confidence.

name: Ayuwanna by Barberyn
conditions_text: Personalized/individualized treatment, traditional protocols, in-house herbal prep
reviews: For the past 4 years, Ayuwanna by Barberyn has been my trusted go-to place whenever I'm in Colombo. It's a proper Ayurveda clinic, built on traditional principles, clear protocols, and guided by highly experienced senior doctors.

Ayuwanna by Barberyn is one of best Ayurveda treatment in Colombo since i have tried many different places. Each visit begins with a consultation with the graceful Dr. Sewwandi, who carefully tailors every treatment to your needs.
Ayuwanna by Barberyn is a quiet gem in the heart of Colombo. From the moment you arrive, the space feels calm and deeply relaxing.
It's such a lovely place with peace, well hidden in the city center of Colombo. The doctor has been practicing for decades and explained the philosophy of Ayurveda to us.

name: Ayurvani Health Care
conditions_text: Unani medicine, specialized treatment plans (12-week protocols)
reviews: If you are searching for a trustworthy caregiver in Colombo, this is an excellent choice. His reliability, kindness, and commitment to quality care make a real difference.

I got treatment from Ayurvani, as the first experience of unani medication. I'm really satisfied with it because my problem was totally cured. The doctor also was friendly and explained the condition very well.
I had a very positive experience at this clinic. Unlike the Western medicine I used before, the results here have been truly satisfactory. The doctor is responsive and friendly.
Had a consultation and follow up with Dr Nizam and she was absolutely wonderful. She reviewed my medical history in depth with me then recommended a specialized treatment plan.

name: Mangalapathy Ayurveda
conditions_text: Bone/joint issues, sprains
reviews: Visited this person for a leg sprain. The only thing she did was talk nothing much. She didn't even care to take a close look for my leg and only provided me with two bottles of her own brand oil.

I went there after phoning her if they have a massage therapy service for my back. The lady gives a fluke answer and in distress I managed to get there. No massage at all. Then she decides on her own and gives me oil to scrub.
Dr Mangalambigai changed my life completely and helped me transform to a completely ayurvedic chemical free life. Their medicines are really effective even though it takes a little time for healing.
Highly recommend the doctor to all your problems. Ayurvedic doctor is the best person to take care of your health.

name: Arugam Bay Ayurveda Panchakarma Institution
conditions_text: Stomach pain, personalized 7-10 day Panchakarma programs
reviews: I had an incredible experience at this Ayurveda center. From the very beginning, I felt I was in expert hands. The doctor spent over an hour conducting a very detailed examination.
I completed a full 7-day program with Doctor including all the procedures which he kindly adapted to suit my possibilities. He was also very accommodating with scheduling.
I did a 10-day Panchakarma treatment here and I'm so glad I did. The experience felt authentic, well-guided, and deeply supportive from start to finish.
I had a full body massage at the center. I am very satisfied with the approach of the entire staff, including the doctor, who knows exactly what he is doing. The prices are great.

name: AYURDI Ayurveda Medical Center & Pharmacy
conditions_text: Detox programs, dosha consultation, sleep issues, 2-week Panchakarma
reviews: I had a wonderful experience at AYURDI Ayurveda Medical Center & Pharmacy in Hikkaduwa. I completed a 3-day detox program, finishing with a glow facial on the final day, and I couldn't be happier.

Great ayurvedic clinic! Dr. Shanika is very experienced with all kinds of treatments and takes lots of time for her patients. Everything from dosha consultation to massages was handled with great profession and fair pricing.
I had a two-week panchakarma programme at the Ayurdi Ayurveda Retreat Medical Centre in Hikkaduwa. I was impressed by the professionalism and good care of Dr Sandya and Dr Shanika.
Dr. Shanika is absolutely wonderful. She is very solution focused and looks to address the root cause. My broken sleep was fixed within two nights.

name: Ayurveda Treatment Center (SDSK Osu Madura)
conditions_text: Backbone damage, sciatica, herniated disc, fractures/dislocations
reviews: My grandmother had a damage in her backbone and was suffering from pain and mobility issues. Within just one week, she showed great improvement and was able to walk without support.
I am incredibly grateful to Dr. Jagath Kahandugoda for the care and treatment I received for my disc bulge back pain. From the very first consultation, I felt listened to, supported, and reassured.

I was suffering from severe sciatica and a herniated disc. Two neurosurgeons told me surgery was the only option. I found Dr. Jagath and decided to try Ayurvedic treatment instead. Within two months, the pain was almost completely gone.
I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to Ayurvedic Dr. Jagath Kahadugoda, a specialist in fractures and dislocations. After just a single visit, I was completely relieved of my back pain.

name: MYND Ayurveda by Dr. Palika Ekanayake
conditions_text: Body discomfort, wart removal, general therapy, also runs Ayurveda training courses
reviews: Excellent Ayurvedic Care. I was feeling very unwell and had severe body discomfort, barely able to walk. I received a 3-hour oil massage followed by a session in the steamer. The clinic is clean, the staff are very skilled.
Myself and 2 friends, visiting from the US, thoroughly enjoyed our treatments. MYND was very accommodating booking us. The spaces were very clean and the entire staff were very nice.
I went here for a wart removal. The place was nice and welcoming. Most importantly the place was very clean. The doctor and her staff was very polite and attentive.
I had a very good experience with the Ayurvedic therapy here. The treatment was professional, and the atmosphere was welcoming and well-managed.

name: Heritance Ayurveda
conditions_text: Weight loss, holistic detox, Ayurvedic Yoga Retreat, nutritionist consultation
reviews: Heritance Ayurvedara Beruwala is simply extraordinary. It is not a normal hotel, but an authentic Ayurveda experience and total regeneration. Treatments are the real strength: competent doctors, personalized therapies daily.
I recently attended an Ayurvedic Yoga Retreat. During my visit I had a consultation with the Ayurvedic Nutritionist Manikya Ranashinghe. I thought she was VERY knowledgeable.
The best combination of perfect medical ayurvedic treatment and marvellous hotel/food. 14 days and 5kg less with very little effort. Most efficient and joyful treatment.

I would like to sincerely thank you for the beautiful moments I experienced during my 16-day stay with you. I enjoyed so many wonderful experiences – from my daily treatments to yoga sessions and meditation.

name: AIDA Ayurveda Resort & Spa
conditions_text: Pain management, Ayurvedic consultations, general treatment
reviews: We visited AIDA Ayurveda Resort yesterday and had a really pleasant experience. The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming throughout our stay. Dr. Chandani for the Ayurvedic consultations and treatments.
We had a wonderful experience at Aida Ayurvedic Resort. The main reason was the staff. They were all courteous friendly enthusiastic & helpful. The therapists were also very skilled at their crafts.
Highly recommend Aida Ayurveda Resort & Spa, best massage & healing treatment I have ever experienced. Came here with pain issues & they fixed the issue very quickly.
I had a wonderful experience at the ayurveda resort. Specially the warm hospitality and the treatment for all the main concerns I had. Dr Radha did an amazing job.

name: FEWAS Ayurveda Resort
conditions_text: Pulse diagnosis-based long-term treatment, personalized therapy (up to 4 weeks)
reviews: It was a wonderful time at the Fewas Ayurveda Resort. Every single member of the team is so warm and welcoming. Fewas has the best doctor – with decades of experience in pulse diagnosis.

Fewas Ayurveda Resort — a place that takes healing seriously, without taking itself too seriously. I spent 4 weeks at Fewas and it was honestly a great experience: high-quality treatments, a calm atmosphere.
A truly exceptional Ayurveda resort! The doctor is highly competent, supported by an outstanding team of skilled therapists. The healthy food is delicious. The accommodations are spotless.
Great resort to visit for meditation and relaxation. Very peaceful and calm, healthy food options, great hospitality, gorgeous beach adjoining the hotel as well!

name: Jeevaka Villa and Ayurveda Retreat
conditions_text: Diagnosis-based treatment, diet/lifestyle advice, family-run retreat
reviews: I had such a wonderful and deeply fulfilling experience at Jeevaka Ayurveda Retreat. From the very beginning, I felt completely at ease and genuinely cared for. The program itself was thoughtfully designed.
My stay at Jeevaka Villa & Ayurveda Retreat was truly a peaceful and rejuvenating experience. The Ayurveda treatments were excellent—very professional and authentic.

The stay here was truly wonderful. From the very beginning, the hospitality of the family that runs this place made me feel incredibly welcome. I loved every treatment, but the yoga in the mornings was definitely my highlight.
My experience at Jeevaka Villa & Ayurveda Retreat was absolutely exceptional. From the serene surroundings to the professional Ayurveda treatments, everything felt thoughtfully designed.

name: Aksaaya Ayurveda Wellness Spa Colombo
conditions_text: Relaxation massage, general wellness
reviews: Amazing staff, great smily and friendly receptionist, professional practitioner, plus great body oil massage! Highly recommend, will come back.
Calm soothing massage performed by Dilan who was very professional and thorough. Good massage technique and intensity. Very clean room and have parking for few cars.
Aksaaya is a great wellness center. I went for a head and foot massage here, the massages were exceptional. Staff is really friendly as well.
If u want to de relax come quick Join wth aksaaya. good medicin and thritments ur body

name: Siddhalepa Clinic Colombo 7
conditions_text: Shirodhara, chakra healing, hand/forearm stiffness
reviews: I had a wonderful experience at Siddhalepa Spa. The atmosphere is calm and inviting, and the products used are excellent. A doctor first evaluates you and then recommends suitable treatments.

Went to get a therapy done on my hand, which has been stiff/sore, and ended up having both forearms massaged and fermented, and had a gorgeous head massage too. Madhushika was friendly and incredibly skilled.

I visited Siddhalepa Ayurveda Clinic (Colombo 7) and it was honestly one of the best wellness experiences I've ever had. After a quick and professional consultation with the doctor, the treatment started.

I recently visited Siddhalepa Spa and had a truly relaxing and rejuvenating experience. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and deeply rooted in traditional Ayurvedic wellness.

name: Luxyana Wellness
conditions_text: General relaxation massage
reviews: Had a wonderful spa experience today. The massage was very relaxing and professional. The therapist gave excellent service and made me feel completely comfortable.

I booked this place based on high ratings, but the reality was extremely disappointing. The consultant spent time explaining the treatment, yet I was not even sure if she was a qualified Ayurveda doctor. The facility is inside a shopping mall, with no washroom.
Deepika was amazing! So professional and great therapist, highly recommend her! The place was extremely clean and smelled amazing.
I had a really great experience at this spa. The place is clean, relaxing, and very well maintained, which immediately made me feel comfortable.
notes: Mall location - privacy concerns in reviews

name: Ceylon Hospital Wellness - Thunmulla
conditions_text: Body oil massage, steam therapy, general wellness with doctor oversight
reviews: I had a full-body massage from Shanika, and it was incredibly relaxing. She did an excellent job and made the whole experience very comfortable. The doctor was also very nice, friendly, and professional.
I had a wonderful experience here. The service was very professional and the staff were very kind and welcoming. My massage therapist Danushi did an amazing job.
7-Star Review for Ceylon Hospital Wellness. I had an exceptional experience. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by the staff and made to feel comfortable and valued.
I had a wonderful full-body oil treatment at CH Wellness. This was my third visit, and once again I had a very relaxing and rejuvenating experience.

name: Santani Wellness Kandy
conditions_text: Detox programme, yoga, meditation, sound bath, breathing sessions
reviews: Santani was one of the most peaceful weeks I have ever experienced. From the moment I arrived, the entire team made me feel incredibly well looked after. My daily treatments were the highlights of my days.
Santani was truly one of the most peaceful and unforgettable wellness experiences I have ever had. The property is absolutely stunning, surrounded by breathtaking nature and incredible views.
My recent four-night stay at Santani Wellness Kandy was one of the most restorative and memorable hotel experiences I have had anywhere in the world.
Our stay at Santani Wellness Kandy was truly unforgettable. The hotel itself is absolutely stunning: peaceful atmosphere, breathtaking mountain views.
notes: High-end resort; some pricing complaints from foreigners

name: Nirwaan Ayurveda Kandy
conditions_text: Oil massage, steam bath, jungle-immersive relaxation
reviews: Stunning location, nestled in amongst dense jungle trees with a flowing river & vibrant wildlife. Each hut is private & has individual showers. The staff are highly skilled, very friendly & helpful.
Nirwaan Ayurveda was an experience like no other. The staff were very kind and welcoming and made me feel at home. It is 100% worth your money because I fell asleep midway through the experience.
I had an Ayurvedic treatment at Nirwan Ayurvedic Center, and it was a wonderful experience. The treatment was very relaxing and professional, and the hospitality was excellent.
Nirvana Ayurveda Spa is a great place to enjoy a relaxing massage. The atmosphere is peaceful, the staff are friendly and professional, and the treatment was very soothing.

name: LAAMA Grand Wellness Kandy
conditions_text: Ayurveda voyage massage packages, head massage, body scrub
reviews: This massage parlour was recommended by my driver, and it turned out to be such a wonderful experience. Michael and Michelle did our massages, and they were both very respectful, attentive, and kind.
There's no way this place is getting anything less than 5 stars from me! The atmosphere is relaxing from the moment you walk in! Then you're greeted with a homemade cool drink.
We visited LAAMA Grand Wellness Kandy after it was recommended. We booked the Ayurveda Voyage Package. Unfortunately, our experience was completely different from the good reviews we read.
Had an incredible experience at Laama Grand Wellness Kandy! My therapist, Ven, was excellent! she was professional, skilled, and constantly made sure I was comfortable.
address: Infront of Toothrelic Temple, 5 Temple St, Kandy 20000

name: Roots Retreat
conditions_text: General relaxation, nature retreat, gym, remote-work friendly
reviews: Absolutely incredible place with an amazing, friendly atmosphere full of tranquillity and positive energy. The architecture and design of this place are immaculate.
We looked for a place to explore the south of Sri Lanka and it was fantastic! We were here with our 2 grown up children. The rooms are big and well designed, very tranquil.
Really loved staying at Roots Retreat. It's a peaceful nature getaway tucked away in a quiet green setting, but still close enough to town.
Roots Retreat is a truly special place where you immediately feel at home. From the very first moment, there is a sense of calm, mindfulness, and authenticity.

name: Sama Retreats - Kosgoda
conditions_text: 9-day Ayurvedic wellness packages, daily massage, organic food
reviews: If you think the previous reviews are all too good to be true (like I did when I booked Sama) - prepare to be proven wrong! My week at Sama was remarkable. The most incredible hospitality, food, treatments and activities.
By some good fortune I found SAMA retreats online and decided to book for a 9 day Ayurvedic wellness package. It exceeded every expectation I had. My daily massages were extraordinary.
Sama is a truly magical place. The owner had a vision to create a haven in nature and he succeeded in every way. The result is utterly serene and peaceful.
I recently spent 3 days and 2 nights at this resort, and it was exactly the peaceful escape I needed. The service was impeccable, with staff who were genuinely attentive and warm.

name: Spa Secret - Ayurveda Spa Negombo
conditions_text: Abhyanga massage, foot/head massage, allergy-aware consultation
reviews: I had the most incredible 60-minute Abhyanga massage with Nadeesha at Spa Secret in Negombo. From the moment I arrived, the experience was exceptional. I left feeling completely refreshed and renewed.
I had a wonderful experience at Spa Secret. The foot massage and head massage were both excellent. The therapists were professional, skilled, and made me feel completely relaxed.
Today I received an exceptionally skilful massage by Meena, probably one of the best I ever had. She truly cared for my wellbeing and helped me to relax.
I went for a massage there today and I'm absolutely thrilled! I felt comfortable as soon as I arrived – everything was very clean, modern, and tastefully decorated.
address: 11/A, St. Jude Lane, Ettukala Rd, Negombo 11500

name: Ayurna Rituals - Luxury Spa Negombo
conditions_text: Full body massage, competitively priced
reviews: My Wife and I had the full body massage. Gayani was my masseuse who had great pressure and great flow throughout, very relaxing and professional. Very welcoming and a reasonable price.
My wife and I went here for a 90 minute full body massage. We chose this place because of the good reviews and the good price. The massage did not disappoint.
Competitively priced and well done full body massage. On a down side they did not provide slippers to take a shower in. Easy to locate and plenty of parking. Very hospitable staff.
Such a nice place! Everyone who works there knows exactly what they're doing. We were welcomed warm and friendly. Really customer friendly prices!

name: Ayur Bliss (Ayu Suwa Arana) Negombo
conditions_text: DIY herbal steam massage, natural therapy
reviews: I had a terrible experience at Ayur Bliss today. The spa is nothing like what they advertise. The staff were not professional, and the overall hygiene was very poor. The treatment rooms were tiny.
I was in Sri Lanka 2 weeks ago, this place just next to my accommodation and walked down to get a massage. The Dr recommend natural steam massage is the best.

I've had many massages but this one wasn't the best one. First of all I asked for a medium pressure massage. First of all the massage was very light pressure. I was very confused when I was told it's over.
One of the best experiences I had in Sri Lanka! I had a full-body massage, and it was incredibly relaxing. Ivon was wonderful, very kind and attentive.

name: Ayurveda Ashram Negombo
conditions_text: Back pain, sciatica relief, herbal bath, stimulation therapy
reviews: I had a wonderful treatment experience at Arved Ashram. I had been suffering from back pain and sciatica for a long time. After the treatment, I felt amazing and experienced significant relief.
Today I found this newly opened business in a quiet area of Negombo beach. I tried the special offer this morning which was an hour head and foot massage - it was excellent.
A wonderful wellness experience! The staff were friendly, professional, and attentive. The treatments were relaxing, and the environment was clean and peaceful.
Highly recommend

name: Jasmin Villa Ayurveda Resort Spa
conditions_text: 3-hour daily therapy programs, steam sauna, herbal baths
reviews: Jasmine Village is a wonderful place to stay, and the deluxe rooms are truly outstanding. We first came here by chance for an afternoon massage and were pleasantly surprised by the high quality.
I had an amazing experience with an authentic Sri Lankan herbal massage here. The location is beautiful, clean, and very well maintained. The therapists are highly experienced and professional.
I had a 75-minute massage for 6,600 rupees, which also included hotel pickup and drop-off – excellent value. The male therapists were outstanding.
The overall experience at this hotel was mixed. The information provided on the website did not match the actual services offered. Cleanliness was below expectations, especially in the rooms.

name: Ayu Care Center / Ayurveda and Yoga
conditions_text: Shirodhara, joint pain massage, post-surgery care
reviews: The doctor is very attentive and, judging by the constant lineup of patients, highly qualified. I ordered several shirodhara and massages of various body parts; the massage was a bit harsh for me, but the oil was good.

I do not recommend this place, especially not for young female travellers. I was given a male masseuse who made me feel very uncomfortable. He regularly left me exposed and in very vulnerable positions.
Unforgettable Personalized Care! I came for the full body massage and steam bath. Dr. Saranga was incredibly helpful, knowledgeable, and provided personal care throughout my visit.
The people were really nice but the massage and the room not so good. The rooms and hygiene were not the best. They didn't change the towel with previous client.
notes: Caution: reported safety concern for solo female travelers

name: Ayur Ayur Ayurveda Retreat
conditions_text: In-house spa, lagoon boat trips, authentic treatments
reviews: We stayed at this hotel in Negombo and honestly had an excellent experience from beginning to end. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful at all times.
Set in unspoilt natural surroundings, the hotel is beautifully appointed, offers professional massage therapists in its own spa area, and also provides a taxi service and boat trips.
My stay at ayur ayur has been exceptional from the first moment I arrived! All the staff are beautiful, friendly and welcoming. The authentic ayurvedic treatments are the best!
5 stars for Kavindra, he made our stay exceptionally smooth. we went out and beyond to serve our needs always with a smile.

name: La Ceylon Wellness at Amagi Aria
conditions_text: Facial, shirodhara, meditation sessions, doctor consultation
reviews: Absolutely amazing treatment! I had the Laawanya Full Body Glowing Ritual and loved every minute of it. I was even more impressed to learn that my therapist was visually impaired.
I had an exceptional experience at the hotel's in-house wellness center. The service is warm, attentive, and very professional. The meditation sessions are truly relaxing.
I had a facial and shirodhara here and they were both 5 stars. The staff are wonderful, you have a free consult with a doctor before your treatment.
My husband and I both had massages today at LA Ceylon Wellness and the staff were fabulous. It was a truly wonderful experience. One of the best massages we've ever had.

name: Helena Ayurvedic Spa & Organic Gifts Ella
conditions_text: Shirodhara, full body massage, very high review volume
reviews: Not sure why generally in sri lanka did not have like nice relax spa centre, instead all look alike this in the picture. I think the skill can be better, reasonable price for one hour.
After reading so many great reviews on Google Maps, I decided to try a massage here as well. My friend recommended the Shirodhara treatment. It was gentle, relaxing, and completely pain-free.
Amazing!!! I had a one hour whole body massage and it was excellent. I live in Thailand and get massages almost every week. This was definitely one of the best I have had.
I had a 60 minute total body massage that elevated my senses not only through the massage itself but also through the aromatic oils and creams which they used.

name: Deergayu Wellness Ayurvedic Spa - Ella
conditions_text: Foot massage, shirodhara, physio-informed, yoga studio
reviews: I had a wonderful 60-minute foot massage with Kumari. It was incredibly relaxing and exactly what I needed. Her technique was perfect, and I felt completely refreshed afterwards.
I highly recommend this place. I had a full-body massage and a Shirodhara treatment, and both were excellent. Chami was my therapist, and he did a fantastic job.
We have made a couple massage and both of our therapist are awesome! They even offer us a herbal tea which is fantastic.
One of the best relaxation experiences in Sri Lanka. We booked a couple's session and it was perfect. The therapists are highly skilled and professional.
address: Grand View, B2 Ella-Passara Rd, Ella 90090

name: Ella Kandy Royal Spa, Ayurveda Treatment Center
conditions_text: Full-body massage, steam therapy, immunity tea
reviews: I had a lovely massage and steam therapy. The environment was beautiful and soothing and I came out totally relaxed. I slept so well.
SEENBEST Ella
Just perfect, all of it. Really recommend
I had an incredibly relaxing Ayurvedic full-body massage with Dr. Kaushalya, and it was such a wonderful experience. I felt so calm, relaxed, and refreshed afterwards.

name: Ceylon Ayurveda Spa Ella
conditions_text: Full body massage, shirodhara, good value pricing
reviews: The place is run by a group of lovely and skilled ladies. I had a full body Ayurvedic Massage and Shirodhura treatment, overall it lasted almost two hours and the whole experience was really relaxing.
Nice Full Body ayurvedic massage, rooms were not so cozy, but I enjoyed the Massage for 70min for a reasonable Price. We enjoyed tea and fruits after the massage.
Amazing experience! I'm such a picky person when it comes to massage, but the masseurs are great! We had the Ayurvedic full body massage 70 mins and they offered tea.
We got a 70-minute Ayurvedic full-body massage here. My masseuse was Chandra, and her pressure was absolutely perfect. I felt incredibly relaxed and completely at ease.

name: Ella Ravan Herbs Ayurwedic Spa
conditions_text: Pulse diagnosis, homemade herbal oils, personalized targeted treatment
reviews: Unlike typical spas, this place offers therapy tailored to you. Dr. Nipun Hasantha begins with a pulse diagnosis, then uses homemade herbal oils, stone therapy, and personalized treatments.
Fantastic experience. I sincerely recommend this place. Nipun is the best! It's not a common massage like the ones you can get anywhere across Sri Lanka. It's tailormade.

I had a massage yesterday with Nipun, and it was honestly a unique experience unlike anything I've ever tried before. Within just a few seconds of observing my body, he was able to identify the two main issues.
The Sri Lankan ayurvedic treatment of Nipun and his sister was exactly what I needed, because I had shoulder pain and it totally disappeared with only 1-2 sessions.
notes: Dr. Nipun Hasantha - tailored approach, well-reviewed

name: Hela Osu Suwapiyasa Ayurweda Spa Ella
conditions_text: Full body/foot massage, aloe vera option, hiker recovery focus
reviews: We had an absolutely wonderful experience at this spa in Sri Lanka. We enjoyed a 30-minute foot massage, and honestly, it was so relaxing and enjoyable that we wished it would never end.
Wow, what an experience. I had a full body 1hour massage by Latha and it made me feel so amazing, I left feeling so rejuvenated! My partner had her massage done by Nisha.
One of the best massages I've ever had. It was the perfect way to relax after our 10km hike to Ella rock. This spa is slightly hidden up the hill from town but absolutely worth finding!
We had a great experience here during our stay in Ella. The atmosphere was calm and welcoming, the treatment was very relaxing, and the staff were kind and professional.

name: Thvindi Ayurvedic Massage Center
conditions_text: Deep tissue massage, leg/foot/full body treatment
reviews: Wish I had found the place sooner! I went there 2 times, had a leg and foot massage and a full body massage. It was wonderful! Everything was very professional.
One of the best massages ever! I had 90 minutes deep tissue massage and the pressure was just enough for my muscular body to feel it deeply, but still balanced.
Excellent service, aromatic scents, strong massage, hot tea at the end. And the most beautiful dog Lulu
My bf and I went for a relaxing full body massage and foot massage. The massage itself was good although they cut it 15min short. Also the setup of this shop is a bit strange.

name: OM Wellness SPA
conditions_text: Cupping therapy, deep tissue, aloe vera massage (sunburn care)
reviews: I booked cupping therapy, Deep tissue massage, and Head massage with Tharushi, and it was amazing. She helped relieve my muscle tension and stress. The spa is clean and peaceful.
Highly recommended! I had a massage with Wathsala and it was absolutely excellent. Very professional, skilled, and attentive throughout the entire session.
The reviews for this place are good and I intended to come here during my 5 nights in Tangalle. It's actually fresh aloe too and it was fantastic.
I had a fantastic Aloe Vera full body massage with Shanika. She was very professional, attentive, and really knew how to relieve tension.

name: TALKING FINGERS SPA
conditions_text: Full-day Ayurvedic ritual, sheerodhara, medicated milk bath
reviews: I had an amazing experience at Talking Fingers Spa in Tangalle. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and perfect for relaxation.
We had such a great experience here! The massage was truly excellent – very relaxing and done with great care and professionalism. We left feeling refreshed and completely relaxed.
We celebrated our 20 years anniversary with a pampering experience at Talking fingers spa in Tangalle. We had a lovely time and we were treated like royalty.
I had two massages back-to-back: one full-body massage with fresh aloe and the other a facial massage with herbs. It was an exceptional experience.

name: Dhamma Kuta Vipassana Meditation Centre
conditions_text: 10-day Vipassana courses, mental clarity
reviews: I visited Dhamma Kuta for a Vipassana course in November 2025. It was a truly wonderful experience. The entire staff was incredibly kind, the natural surroundings were beautiful, and the atmosphere was peaceful.
If you are planning to do vipassana for first time then Dhamma kuta is great place to start this journey of mind purity. Just take the plunge and sign up for 10 days beginner course.
I completed my first Vipassana retreat here and had a wonderful experience. The centre is so beautiful with wonderful nature and people and a very supportive atmosphere.
Best place for receiving right meditation technique and deep philosophy about lifestyle.

name: International Vipassana Meditation Center - Colombo 07
conditions_text: Meditation & religious programs
reviews: Very calm and peaceful place located at Colombo. They have meditation and religious programs. We can take sponsorship of these programs. But not enough parking facilities.
One of the best meditation center located in heart of Colombo, Srilanka. Great place to learn about the Buddhist meditation according to the Supreme Buddha.
In a neighborhood that seems to have an abundance of Buddhist religious establishments, this meditation center's grounds are attractive and partially open to the public.
I came to visit this international centre. There is not one sign in English. The signs are all in Sinhalese. The reception seemed empty. Zero information and zero welcome for foreigners.
notes: Limited English signage - foreigner accessibility gap

name: Dhammasobha Vipassana Meditation Centre
conditions_text: 10-day Vipassana
reviews: IMPORTANT: It's too noisy for meditation. I wouldn't recommend this place because it is very close to the main road. You can hear traffic noise, music from the road, and sounds.
Stillness Amidst Noise. Dhamma Sobha sits on a wooded hillside, about 47 kilometers from Colombo – the closest Vipassana center to the city.
Vipassana is a really interesting technique. For me the whole experience was way too religious. Everyone has to decide for themselves if Vipassana is a good thing for them.
I followed the 10-day Vipassana course here about a year ago. A few days before arriving, I read quite a lot of reviews mentioning the noise. I still decided to go and don't regret coming here!
notes: Some noise complaints - near main road

name: Dhamma Arana Vipassana Meditation Center
conditions_text: Meditation retreat

name: Weligama Vipassana Meditation
conditions_text: Guided meditation, Buddhist philosophy, short sessions
reviews: This meditation center is truly a place of peace and healing. The American monk teaches with great kindness, patience, and deep understanding of the mind.
I had the opportunity to visit this place three times for meditation, and each experience was truly meaningful. It was very interesting to learn more about Buddhist philosophy.
I am so grateful to have found out about this venue and had the opportunity to attend the guided meditation and dhamma talk with Bhante. Highly recommended!
If you're looking for peace or a moment of stillness, I recommend Weligama Vipassana Meditation. It's a place filled with calm, but also with Buddhist wisdom.

name: Dhamma Dharani Vipassana Meditation Centre
conditions_text: 10/20/30/45-day Vipassana courses
reviews: Just finished a 10 day retreat there. Best center I've been yet. Only single rooms. Nice walking area.
Tranquil Oasis for Deep Meditation. Nestled next to two serene lakes, this center offers a perfect blend of natural beauty and peaceful atmosphere.
A great place to practice Vipassana meditation, there are 10 days course, 20 days, 30 days, 45 days course.
How to find words for this experience? Life-changing that's for sure! I finally released the fear of death and tension that I lived with in my body for 45 years.

name: Kanduboda Siyane Vipassana Meditation Centre
conditions_text: Mahasi-method insight meditation
reviews: I spent some of the most beautiful days of my life here. If you're genuinely interested in Vipassana meditation, this is truly the place to be.
I spent a beautiful week in this place. I just found it by chance in Google and sent an email asking to join a Vipassana retreat. I just loved it, it was a peaceful week.
calm place to do meditation, Buddhist temple in Pugoda road
A Truly Authentic Vipassana Experience (Mahasi Tradition). Kanduboda Siyane is one of the oldest and most respected Vipassana meditation centres in Sri Lanka.
verified: Yes - one of oldest centers in SL

name: Dhamma Anuradha Vipassana Meditation Centre
conditions_text: 10-day Vipassana, jungle setting
reviews: Did my second 10 day sitting course there and after 10 day service. The center is really simple yet really welcoming environment surrounded by jungle and sounds of animals.
This is so peaceful and calm place of Dhamma. We had everyday delicious Sri Lankan rice and curry and fruit juices. Rooms are small but you have everything you need.
It's full of animals this place. In the rooms you have mosquitoes, frogs, spiders and other small insects. But I had a very good experience because the place is beautiful.
Vipassana Center Review. It was my first Vipassana course, and the experience was truly transformative. By the end of the course, I felt a deep sense of calm and clarity.
notes: Reports of improved sleep, reduced headaches

name: Poojalena Aranya Senasanaya (Forest Monastery)
conditions_text: Forest meditation, healing environment, near Sinharaja
reviews: Very beautiful location with healing environment. Good for meditation and relaxing with natural resources. Buddhist monks are very kind and helpful.
Forest monastery under the tradition of kalyani yogashrama, one would need to take a 2km walk from the parking point to the main hall.
So quiet forest temple in hedigalla srilanka, it's close to sinharaja forest.
Take a moment to relax at a Buddhist temple situated in the serene surroundings of a wetland forest.

name: Sri Ayush Ayurvedic Clinic
conditions_text: Back pain, Dr. Thedsanamurthy Sabesan specialist
reviews: I had the misfortune of arriving in Jaffna with severe back pain – the kind that makes even sitting, sleeping, or simply enjoying your surroundings impossible. Under the care of Dr. Thedsanamurthy Sabesan, I experienced one of the most effective treatments I have ever received.
Many thanks for having accept my request: in very good health, asking for a ayurveda body massage. It's the best massage I received in Sri Lanka. You have a high level of expertise.
I recently had a wonderful Ayurvedic massage at Sri Ayush Ayurvedic Clinic. The massage was performed by two skilled doctors, and I felt very comfortable and well taken care of.
I've had many Ayurvedic massages over the years while living in India, but this one in Jaffna was by far the best. I felt incredible relief from muscular pain.
notes: Highly effective for acute back pain relief

name: Sanjeevi Siddha Ayurvedic Hospital & Pharmacy
conditions_text: Chronic diseases, musculoskeletal, respiratory, skin conditions (Siddha+Ayurveda)

name: Sri Ayush Ayurvedic Hospital (Brown Road)
conditions_text: Skilled doctor-led treatment, quality massage therapy

name: MATHER Siddha Ayurvedic Centre
conditions_text: Stomach ulcers, abdominal pain, digestive disorders - Dr. Rebilishanth

name: Thisara Ayurveda Hospital
conditions_text: Deep tissue massage, doctor consultation before treatment, general ailments
notes: Endorsed by a visiting Ayurveda doctor in reviews

name: District Ayurvedic Hospital (Galle)
conditions_text: Abdominal spasms, general Ayurvedic treatment, free government service
reviews: I had severe spasms in my belly and Dr. Shani consulted me, after about a month, I have a really good improvement and I still continue the treatments. Highly recommended
open everyday. free. Friendly service. No polythene, plastic zone.
The very best place to get ayurvedic treatment.
No people like old medical system

name: Sujeewaka Arana Ayurveda Medical and Wellness Center
conditions_text: General Ayurvedic care, professional consultation

name: Arogya Ayurveda - Panchakarma Treatment Centre
conditions_text: Panchakarma (16-day programs), flexible self-managed accommodation/food

name: Santhusha Ayurveda Medical Center
conditions_text: Back pain, leg pain, joint pain - Dr. Lahiru, Dr. Hasini
reviews: I had a great experience at Santhusha Ayurveda Medical Centre for my back pain. It's a wonderful family-owned practice where Dr. Lahiru and Dr. Hasini provide incredible patient care.
I had been suffering from severe back pain for about a year. However, after learning about this doctor and visiting him, he took an X-ray and completely cured my back pain within about a week.
I had severe leg pain and received treatment at Santhusha Ayurveda Medical Center, and I am extremely happy with the results. Now my leg pain is completely cured.
Life-Changing Ayurvedic Treatment. I visited Santhusha Ayurveda suffering from severe back pain and stiffness throughout my entire body and joints. The transformation has been absolutely incredible!

name: Suvayu Ayurveda Medical Center
conditions_text: Long-term chronic condition care since 2015, mobility restoration

name: Aamco Ayurvedic Industries
conditions_text: Cancer support treatment (adjunct), general ailments - Dr. Unais
reviews: This family is a good Ayurveda medical team. The daughter is a doctor and make the consultation. The father make the medicine. And the mother make good massage.
One of best places to do Ayurvedic massage in Galle. They use homemade medicines. That's what makes this place more special.
I appreciate your hospitality!! I'm glad I could experience the real Ayurvedic massage at a reasonable price. They're very welcomed and warm.
I experienced a full body massage by Dr. Unais and I can highly recommend it to anyone! I felt very nice and relieved afterwards, he is a kind, open and very lovely person.

name: Procare Ayush Ayurvedic Home
conditions_text: Full body treatment programs (up to 3 weeks), family-run, garden herbs
reviews: We had a wonderful experience at this Ayurvedic clinic. We spent 5 days with our friends. Doctor Shalika and Amali and the whole staff is attentive, kind, and truly caring.
I spent three weeks doing my Ayurveda cure at Procare Ayush Ayurvedic Home and can absolutely recommend it. The care provided by the medical team was excellent, highly competent, attentive.
I had a wonderful experience at Procare Ayush Ayurvedic Home! We booked a couple's Ayurvedic full body massage, and it was fantastic. Dr. Shalika was a great host.
We were recommended Procare by Suresh, the manager at Three Gables. It was excellent - very clean - the consultation was informative, the treatments very relaxing.
notes: Dr. Shalika - highly personalized, homestay feel

name: Damsiri Ayurveda Hospital
conditions_text: Sciatica specialist - 40 years treating experience

name: District Ayurveda Hospital - Aparekka
conditions_text: Arthritis (specific clinic days), multi-doctor general treatment, eye treatment
notes: One of largest govt Ayurveda hospitals; token system

name: Ancient Healers Ayurvedic Center
conditions_text: Dosha-balance consultation, joint/muscle issues - 32 years experience doctor
notes: Off tourist track, genuine local reputation

name: Dhara Healing Ayurveda Treatment Centre
conditions_text: Herbal steam bath (unique wooden chamber), full body massage
reviews: We had a wonderful experience at the Dhara Healing Ayurveda Treatment Center in Nuwara Eliya, where we booked as a family an Ayurvedic massage together. The atmosphere felt very welcoming and trustworthy.
My visit to Dhara Healing Ayurveda Treatment Center was absolutely amazing! From the moment I entered, I felt calm and welcomed by the soothing music and relaxing scent.
The therapist I had was good and professional. Nevertheless the whole experience was unpleasant. First of all the hygiene was questionable. The massage bed was covered only with small paper towel.
Very relaxing and aromatic Ayurvedic treatment in Nuwara Eliya. The massage therapist had good pressure and was very professional. This is mid-range and value for money.

name: Thilaka Ayurveda Treatment Center
conditions_text: Fireplace-side massage, traditional herb oil, steam cylinder
notes: Mixed reviews - some oil quality complaints
address: 22, Lady Mc Cullum's Drive, Nuwara Eliya 22200

name: The Grand Spa Nuwara Eliya
conditions_text: Thai + Ayurvedic massage, honeymoon packages
reviews: To start with, our masseuses were excellent. We came for the honeymoon package. However, 2 days ago the spa team were informed that the pool and spa facilities were being refurbished.
I had an amazing experience at Grand Thai Spa. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and beautifully maintained. The staff were extremely professional and friendly.
Great professional experience! Kirna was very friendly and had very strong hands. You can specify what kind of pressure points need to be handled and the service was amazing and clean.
I recently had a wonderful spa treatment at The Grand Spa in Nuwara Eliya, and it was truly an amazing experience. A very special thank you to Weda for her exceptional service.

name: Thilaka Ayurvedic Treatment Center & Spa (Haputale)
conditions_text: Post-hike massage, herbal compress, steam sauna
reviews: We have a lot of experience to compare, and I would love to leave a higher rating because Vihara and Tharu—the ladies who give the massages—are very nice, welcoming, and friendly.
Beware of scams! This centre was recommended to us by a local. On arrival, we were told that the full-body massage would cost 15,000 rupees. That seemed quite expensive to us.
We had a lovely time with Vihara and Tharu. Very kind ladies and a my boyfriend and I had lovely hour long massage and steam after our Pekoe trail.
Rustic authentic massage with steam cupboard was nice to do on a cold day, the massage was with vihara who was very kind and gave a nice massage, good to do after a trek.
notes: Popular with Pekoe Trail hikers; price consistency concerns

name: Aruliya Care Wellness Galle Fort
conditions_text: Head/back/shoulder massage, affordable pricing

name: Haritha Lanka Ayurveda Piyasa
conditions_text: Full body massage, steam bath, shirodhara
notes: Also functions as massage training school

name: Rideekanda Forest Monastery
conditions_text: 7-day Vipassana retreat, mountaintop setting
notes: Highly rated, structured but gentle retreat

name: Mahamevnawa Buddhist Monastery - Nuwara Eliya
conditions_text: Meditation guidance, Dhamma discussion, multilingual (Sinhala/Tamil/English)
notes: Accessible for casual visitors, not just long retreats

conditions_text: Open retreats for beginners and experienced meditators

name: Meethirigala Nissarana Vanaya Forest Monastery
conditions_text: Satipatthana Vipassana (Mahasi tradition), flexible 1-10+ day stays
